# atlas — Claude Code context layout

| Content | Mechanism | Location | Rationale |
|---|---|---|---|
| Conventional commits, `make check` before PR, trunk-based dev | Root CLAUDE.md | `CLAUDE.md` | Applies to every task in the repo, so it belongs in always-loaded context. Kept to a few lines. |
| Repo map + pointers to service files | Root CLAUDE.md | `CLAUDE.md` | A one-line-per-service map orients Claude without loading service details it may not need. |
| `api/gen/` is generated by `make proto` | Subdirectory CLAUDE.md | `api/CLAUDE.md` | Loads only when Claude works in `api/`, so other services don't pay for it. |
| Block edits to `api/gen/**` | PreToolUse hook | `.claude/settings.json` + `.claude/hooks/block-gen-edits.sh` | Hand-edits are silently lost, so enforce deterministically instead of relying on Claude to remember. |
| `npm test` launches browsers; use `npm run test:unit` | Subdirectory CLAUDE.md | `web/CLAUDE.md` | A web-only quirk. Scoping it keeps the root lean and loads it exactly when relevant. |
| `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` before importing DAGs | Subdirectory CLAUDE.md | `pipeline/CLAUDE.md` | A pipeline-only quirk. Better still, bake it into the pipeline's make targets so it can't be forgotten. |
| 20-step incident-response runbook | Skill, distributed via org plugin marketplace | `incident-response/SKILL.md` (+ `references/runbook.md`) in the company plugin repo, not atlas | A repeated procedure used identically company-wide. A Skill loads on demand, and a plugin gives one source of truth across all repos instead of copies drifting. |
| Live SQL against the analytics warehouse | MCP server (read-only role) | `.mcp.json` at repo root (or user scope for analysts outside atlas) | Needs real-time external data. MCP is the connectivity layer. Use read-only credentials from env, never committed. |
| Warehouse schema notes / metric definitions (optional) | Skill bundled with the MCP plugin | Company plugin repo | Teaches Claude which tables define "product metrics" without bloating CLAUDE.md for non-analysts. |
| Personal preferences (editor style, verbosity) | User CLAUDE.md | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md` | Personal preferences shouldn't be committed to the shared repo. |

## Notes
- If the org-wide conventions are truly company-wide across all repos, move them to a
  managed/enterprise CLAUDE.md and drop them from the atlas root to avoid duplication (SSoT).
- Subdirectory CLAUDE.md files load when Claude reads files in that directory. The `api/gen`
  hook is the backstop for the case where that hasn't happened yet.
- Hook sketch: match `Edit|Write|MultiEdit`. If `tool_input.file_path` matches `*/api/gen/*`,
  exit 2 with "api/gen is generated — edit the .proto and run `make proto`."

### `CLAUDE.md`

```markdown
# atlas

Monorepo with three services. Each has its own CLAUDE.md with service-specific gotchas.
- `api/` — Go, gRPC
- `web/` — React/TypeScript
- `pipeline/` — Python, Airflow

## Workflow
- Commits use Conventional Commits (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:`, …).
- `make check` must pass before opening any PR. Run it from the repo root.
- Trunk-based: branch from `main`, keep branches short-lived, and merge small and often.

## Gotchas
- Never hand-edit `api/gen/`. It is regenerated by `make proto`. Change the `.proto` files instead.
- In `web/`, run `npm run test:unit`. `npm test` launches real Playwright browsers.
- In `pipeline/`, set `AIRFLOW_HOME=pipeline/.airflow` before importing or testing DAGs.
```

---

The three gotchas are repeated in the root as one-liners. They're cheap, and they protect the cases where Claude touches a service without its subdirectory CLAUDE.md loaded yet. If you'd rather keep strict SSoT, delete that section and rely on the subdirectory files plus the `api/gen` hook.
